items.value: it's very good at keeping the wearer warm and snuggly, and very comfortable to wear. Also covers hands when the sleeves are pulled down which is great. If you have long arms, there are Kangroo pockets to stick your hands in.

items.label: ♥ Revisable Wearable Blanket
items.value: Reversible Ultra Soft Sherpa Fleece Comfy Snuggle Hoodie, Shell cotton velvet teddy fabric, backing with fluffy Sherpa fleece. items.label: ♥ One Size Fits All
items.value: The large oversized hoodie blanket is good for just about anyone, easily covering the torso and down to the knees for smaller people! Bring it to camping ,enjoying outdoor concert, lounging around the house, reading a book, watching TV，on the computer, at sporting events, drive in or sleepover take it anywhere you want.

items.label: ♥ A Great Gift
items.value: Wraped in yellow bow with color card, Perfect gift for any occasions, such as Christams, Birthday, Thanksgiving, Mother's day, Father's day, New Year's Eve, Anniversaries, Back to school, graduation & prime gift...

items.label: ♥ CARE-FREE WASH
items.value: The huge hood & pocket keeps your head & hands toasty warm in chilly morning and night. Machine Washable: Gaint fluffy hoodie can be machine washed at 30 °C, and tumble dry separately on low.
